renderer_limitation: The installed grouped_bar renderer requires a zero minimum and cannot preserve the negative Completion change, so this custom SVG follows the skill tokens and validator contract.
title: Similar Macro gain, different axis profiles
description: A compact measured comparison places the nearly equal Macro relative gains in a summary strip and gives most of the canvas to the four axis-level percentage-point changes. Macro relative gain is 10.93% locally and 10.78% in the paper. Local versus paper changes are Call 4.93 versus 1.40, Completion 7.04 versus -2.80, Slot 7.01 versus 27.80, and Relevance 5.69 versus 8.70 percentage points. The conditions use different checkpoints, preference data, and judge backends and are not one common effect estimate.
